project_title: Z-ZOA: Out-of-Sample Reconstruction and H I Validation of Large-Scale Structure Across the Galactic Zone of Avoidance
sealed_by: Z-ZOA Calculation Room Independent Integrity Working Group
primary_hypothesis: The unmasked cosmic matter field inferred from Cosmicflows-4, 2MRS, and decontaminated HIZOA-S data anticipates a statistically significant excess density at the withheld positions of the MeerKAT Vela-SMGPS galaxy distribution.
exclusion_rule: Strict quarantine of all 39 known HIZOA detections residing in the Vela footprint [260 <= l <= 290 deg, -2 <= b <= 1 deg].
exploratory_gating_clause: Any analysis utilizing modified smoothing scales, alternative footprints, or adjusted selection cuts evaluated after unsealing must be designated EXPLORATORY and segregated from confirmatory claims.
